'''sithborg Jammin QMC''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Player:''' [[sithborg]]
* '''Published:''' 23 November 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}

* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony

(V) (Virtual Set 7), Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5), Imperial Atrocity (V) (Virtual Set 6): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

A modified version of the QMC I took to states.  Why I still didn't mind the errata.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published (no section counts given).
* Original-era (V): Flash Of Insight (V) (VS5); Beldon's Eye (V), Princess Leia (V) x2, Kebyc (V) x2, Bright Hope (V) x2, Imperial Atrocity (V) (VS6); Uh-oh! (V), Tantive IV (V) (VS7).
* Posted 'Han w/blaster' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Chewie, Protecter' Chewbacca, Protector; 'Figran D'an' Figrin D'an; 'Doik Na'ts' Doikk Na'ts.

== Strategy ==

Well, this is a modified version of the deck I took to states. Went 2-1 (the lose due to a stupid mistake on my part)

It is a fairly simple deck.  You can flip by 2nd turn usually, 1st a lot of times.  It is a fairly defensive deck, you set up drains and retrieval at Cloud City, with some evasion to protect you.  Retrieval from Uh-Oh (V), CC celebration, and off the edge helps keep you ahead of the opponent.
